profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer in Microsoft Defender
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Java and C#. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Science from San Jose State University.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on Angular and Electron UI for customer service agents.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on a Java REST server using the Restlet framework as well as an AngularJS based web console. Also worked on C++ debugging and development.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Responsibilities include QA Testing, rapid prototype development, code refactoring and integration, and customer support issue investigation. Languages used are Java, Javascript, and C++. Frameworks  used include Restlet and AngularJS. I have also been involved in testing for Thingspan using Spark.

positions.title: QA Intern
positions.description: Worked on QA test reporting framework for windows systems using python and bash scripting. Conversion to Java based reporting system was in development.
